svg.title: Ten principles, each beside the case it decided
svg.desc: Ledger of LIA's ten principles with the case each decided, the chapter where it was told, and its dated anchors on a 1900 to 2030 axis.
svg.text: EDGELESS LAB / LATENT INFORMATION ARCHAEOLOGY / PLATE IV-02-1
TEN PRINCIPLES
Each of the ten principles decided something in a case already told
The principle as LIA states it, the case beside it, what the principle decided there, and the dates that case puts on the record.
PRINCIPLE
CASE, CHAPTER, AND WHAT THE PRINCIPLE DECIDED
DATED ANCHORS
event
span
Evidence, provenance, novelty, questions, contradictions
Evidence precedes assertion.
A plausible narrative is not a substitute for a traceable
evidentiary chain.
Vesuvius Challenge grand prize
Ch. I-01
The bar was fixed at launch: four passages of 140 characters, at least 85
percent recoverable. Papyrologists reviewed 15 columns of text in
anonymized submissions and a technical team audited the code. Only then
was $700,000 awarded.
Provenance is part of the discovery.
A finding should preserve its source artifacts, dates,
transformations, and inferential steps.
The archive of Zenon
The papers surfaced in 1911, were sold from about 1914, and sit in 21
collections. The 1980 Guide rebuilt their relations and keeps Zenon's dated
endorsements apart from scholars' attributions.
Novelty is investigated, not presumed.
Rediscovery is valuable, but must not be misrepresented as
original discovery.
Page, Brin and colleagues, 1998
Ch. II-05
The report credits the literature on citation analysis, says where the web
departs from it, and claims only a ranking method that weights each link by
the rank of the page it came from.
The question may itself be the discovery.
Recognizing that a problem can be asked differently is a
legitimate outcome.
Roth, Sönmez and Ünver, 2004
Ch. III-11
The incompatible donor-patient pair was posed as an exchange problem.
The 1974 housing-market model already existed and two-pair exchanges
had been proposed in 1986, so the credit goes to the reformulation.
Contradictions are excavation sites.
Inconsistencies can indicate missing variables, incompatible
assumptions, errors, or genuine opportunities for explanation.
Madoff's returns and the options market
Ch. II-01, III-09
Outside analysts dug where the reported strategy and exchange volume
disagreed; examiners accepted his answers. The contradiction marked
where an independent record, the clearing records, had to be read.
Similarity, time, negative results, methods, circulation
Similarity is a lead, not proof.
Semantic proximity, analogy, and correlation may initiate
inquiry but cannot independently establish causation or truth.
Survival-weighting analogy
Ch. III-12
The sampling analogy opened the inquiry. Review found that archives lack
the known inclusion probability the transfer depends on. Verdict:
KILL-NOVELTY + KILL-SPECIFICATION + DEFER-CORPUS.
Time is an evidentiary constraint.
Claims about what could have been discovered earlier must
exclude information unavailable at the historical cutoff,
including information introduced through model training or
retrieval.
Cohen and Frazzini, 2008
Ch. II-03
Customer links for 1980 to 2004 were used only after a six-month gap from
fiscal year-end, so no relation was credited before it was public.
Negative results belong in the record.
Failed connections, rejected hypotheses, and uncertainty
should be retained when possible so future investigators do not
repeat the same excavation.
Ratio-law candidate
Ch. III-12
Closed at first review: no universal sign, the split between attention and rule
undefined, and a 2024 study already in print. Kept as a rejected candidate,
with what was never attempted.
Methods are replaceable; standards are not.
Human scholarship, statistical analysis, graph reasoning,
language models, and future computational systems can all
participate.
Swanson by hand; Co-Scientist by agents
Ch. I-01, III-04
One searched indexes and read what came back; the other runs a Supervisor
and six specialized agents. Both outputs were held to one standard: a
candidate until tested.
Knowledge should circulate.
Publish methods, evidence, and findings as openly as possible,
consistent with privacy, source rights, safety, and the
legitimate interests of affected people.
Released scans, disclosed customers
several chapters
Scans released to anyone who wanted them, a rule that names any customer
over 10 percent of sales, and an invitation to readers. Each of the four limits
bears on a case: the Institut de France's rights in the scrolls, safety among
Co-Scientist's criteria, a named person in the Madoff complaints, patients
waiting for a kidney.
Source: LIA long-form, Chapter IV-02, and the cases it cites: Vesuvius Challenge 2024; Trismegistos Zenon archive record; Page, Brin et al. 1998; Roth, Sönmez and
Ünver 2004; SEC inspector general testimony; Cohen and Frazzini 2008; Swanson 1986; Co-Scientist, Nature 2026; LIA stage-zero closures 2026.
